1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use; and __a modulation control system configured to modulate valve operation to achieve fine pressure control in the brake chamber__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __a plurality of first valves and a plurality of second valves arranged in a staged configuration__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, wherein the larger and smaller valves operate in coordinated sequence__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at __high frequency modulation speeds for precision pressure adjustment__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by __electronically controlled binary actuators with feedback regulation__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive __real-time control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for continuously determining the pressure in the brake chamber and adjusting valve operation accordingly__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive __real-time data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds, and to dynamically control braking force based thereon using adaptive algorithms__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed __using closed-loop feedback control__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising __one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; a central compressed air storage tank; and an integrated electronic control module for coordinating braking operations across multiple wheels__.
